scope: Method+path coverage for eight current portal Swagger entry definitions; excludes separate PPUBS/Assignment Center/TMSearch clients and public methods not represented by these entry definitions.
source_method: 63 operations parsed from original archived entry files; 29 companion operations read from current rendered official Swagger UI.
evidence_limits: Method symbol presence and test-file links are navigation evidence, not proof of every parameter, content type or error contract.

Direct live evidence is matching method/path HTTP200 interactions; declared bulk HTTP302 followed by approved-host HTTP200 is counted separately as a successful workflow. Replay tests establish semantic validation separately.
Raw PTAB companion bytes and common schema remain unarchived. Rendered operation names verify HTTP method/path, not complete schema resolution.
The main text-to-search entry declares no HTTP operation and is excluded.

Location.description: URL of the actual file download

operations.contract_anomaly: Official source nests responses at path-item level; GET description explicitly declares HTTP302.

redirect_workflow_evidence.evidence_scope: Declared HTTP302 followed in same recording by approved public host HTTP200; linked replay validates ZIP bytes.
